text:
maria-finance: Incoming invoice NL-331 from 'Scandi Metrics AS' dated 2026-03-12 shows 25% MVA charged. PO expects net B2B treatment. AP ticket #AP-10234 with PDF attached. Please advise.
chris-legal: Norway MVA rules: confirm if vendor is VAT-registered (MVA). Ask them for MVA number + current registration extract or reissue without MVA.
ashley-sales: Vendor contact says tax was automated by their billing system. They're open to reissue but want sample wording.
maria-finance: Suggested ask: 1) Reissue invoice NL-331 without Norwegian MVA and add "Reverse charge - recipient liable for VAT" OR 2) Send MVA reg number and company extract showing VAT liability. Also request a credit note referencing NL-331 if they reissue.
ap-bot: AP hold placed on NL-331 — status: HOLD (reason: VAT dispute).
oliver-finance: Approving AP hold. Set reminder: escalate to procurement in 7 business days if no reissue.
procurement: If vendor declines reissue, procurement will request contract amendment for net pricing and tag legal.
tax-bot: Vendor master missing field: mva_number. Please upload docs to clear hold.
maria-finance: Sent email template to vendor, cc legal/sales/procurement. Next steps checklist: 1) vendor reissue or provide MVA + extract; 2) treasury confirm bank details on replacement invoice; 3) AP reprocess net invoice and reverse VAT; 4) update vendor master.
chris-legal: Add place-of-supply rationale to AP ticket for audit trail.
ashley-sales: I'll nudge the rep tomorrow if no reply today. :+1:
maria-finance: Thanks — will update thread when vendor responds. If anyone spots other invoices from Scandi Metrics with MVA in last 6 months, flag them for batch credit request.
